# Calum Lill

**Calum Andrew Lill** (born September 1995) is an English actor known for his roles in British television soap operas . He gained recognition for his portrayal of Joel Deering in the ITV soap opera Coronation Street from September 2023 to June 2025 . Lill has also appeared in other notable British soaps including Hollyoaks, Doctors, and Holby City .

## Early life and education

Lill was born in September 1995 in Manchester, England . He developed an interest in acting after participating in a drama class at school, initially motivated by the opportunity to work as an extra on the television series Waterloo Road . During his time on Waterloo Road, he had a scene with actress Chelsee Healey, who recommended drama classes that helped launch his career .

After completing his education, Lill was awarded a scholarship to study acting at the Arts Educational Schools in London, where he earned a BA in acting in 2018 .

## Career

### Early career and breakthrough

Following his graduation in 2018, Lill began his professional acting career with small roles in British television dramas . His early appearances included a brief role in the BBC daytime soap opera Doctors, which he described as "two days filming" that made him feel "like \[he'd] just been cast as the lead in the new Scorsese epic" . He later appeared in an episode of the medical drama Holby City .

The COVID-19 pandemic in 2020 significantly impacted Lill's early career, as he noted: "lockdown hit... That threw a spanner in the works" . Despite these setbacks, he continued to audition for roles and in late 2020 received an unexpected offer for approximately eight episodes on the Channel 4 soap opera Hollyoaks . The producers stated they "remembered \[him]" from previous auditions and he "didn't need to audition" . This was his first extended role lasting more than a couple of days .

### Hollyoaks and other early roles

In Hollyoaks, Lill portrayed PC Carlton Smith, a co-worker and friend of George Kiss, from March to July 2021 . During this period, he also worked various jobs to support himself, including selling cars and working at a Junkyard Golf Club . He later described his experience as a car salesman, saying "I was selling cars while auditioning for Corrie and I hated it" .

In 2022, after his Hollyoaks role ended, Lill worked at a paella stand at festivals alongside former Coronation Street actors Jenny Platt and Rupert Hill . This experience proved significant for his career, as Rupert Hill advised him that if Coronation Street producers were interested in him, they would contact him .

### Coronation Street role

Lill's breakthrough came when he was cast as Joel Deering in Coronation Street in 2023 . He had previously auditioned unsuccessfully for the show and was considering quitting acting after what he described as "14 or 15 years" of struggle . He recalled: "I thought, 'It's been 15 years, I'm going to have to drop it, nothing's happening'" .

His character Joel Deering was introduced as a duty solicitor helping the character Lauren Bolton, but later developed into a more complex role involving a romantic storyline with Dee-Dee Bailey . The character was eventually revealed to have a secret wife and young daughter, and later emerged as a villain who had groomed and physically assaulted Lauren Bolton .

To prepare for this challenging role, Lill studied police interviews with serial killer Ted Bundy and consulted with the Maggie Oliver Foundation, a charity supporting survivors of sexual exploitation . His performance earned him a nomination for Best Villain at the 2024 Inside Soap Awards .

Lill's character was killed off in September 2024 as part of a whodunit mystery storyline . He appeared in 76 episodes of Coronation Street from September 2023 to June 2025 .

### Other works

In addition to his television work, Lill has appeared in several short films including "I Can See Clearly Now," "Sleep Warm," "Heads or Tails," and "Down, Not Out" . His film and television credits also include an appearance in the drama series In the Club .

## Personal life

Lill resides in Manchester with his fiancée, Roberta McClarron, who works in public relations and marketing . The couple began their relationship in 2021 and became engaged in 2022 . When announcing their engagement, Lill joked: "About time I made an honest woman of her" .

In December 2025, Lill announced via Instagram that he and McClarron are expecting their first child, due in April 2026 . His social media post included a playful reference to his television career, with the caption "New character dropping April '26" .

Lill has been open about his struggles in the acting industry before achieving success. He revealed he was "close to quitting acting" before landing his Coronation Street role, describing the period as "tough" . He has credited McClarron with providing support during his career difficulties, stating: "It wasn't just happiness for me getting the job, she knew what I was going through and that I was struggling" .

4.description: Emmerdale's Tom and Belle story and EastEnders' Six drama are among this year's Inside Soap Award nominees.
4.content:
This year's Inside Soap Award nominations include nods for [_Emmerdale_](https://www.digitalspy.com/soaps/emmerdale/)'s Tom and Belle coercive control story and [_EastEnders_](https://www.digitalspy.com/soaps/eastenders/)' cover-up for The Six.

The 2024 ceremony will take place in London in September, with fan voting officially opening on all of the major categories from Tuesday (July 16) at noon at [_Inside Soap_](http://www.insidesoap.co.uk/).

The coveted Best Storyline category includes nominations for some of the most hard-hitting scenes of the year, including the mystery over [Lauren Bolton's disappearance](https://www.digitalspy.com/soaps/coronation-street/a61546074/coronation-street-spoilers-lauren-bolton-second-twist/) in [_Coronation Street_](https://www.digitalspy.com/soaps/coronation-street/).

_Corrie_'s issue-based story around [Paul Foreman's motor neurone disease (MND) diagnosis](https://www.digitalspy.com/soaps/coronation-street/a60591286/coronation-street-paul-foreman-breathing-struggles/) and subsequent life changes has also been nominated for Best Storyline.

![Image 1: paul foreman, billy mayhew, coronation street](https://hips.hearstapps.com/hmg-prod/images/billy-mayhew-paul-foreman-coronation-street-668eadccabfb2.jpg?resize=980:*)

[_Hollyoaks_](https://www.digitalspy.com/soaps/hollyoaks/) has been recognised in the category for the heartbreaking scenes of Leela Lomax and Joel Dexter's baby loss, in addition to the sibling sexual abuse story involving Frankie and JJ Osborne.

The Best Storyline nominations for _EastEnders_ are for [The Six covering up the murder of Keanu Taylor](https://www.digitalspy.com/soaps/eastenders/a61596800/eastenders-matt-di-angelo-dean-wicks-exit/), plus George Knight discovering [the truth about his adoption](https://www.digitalspy.com/soaps/eastenders/a60191205/eastenders-spoilers-george-mystery-character-revealed/).

_Emmerdale_'s pair of Best Storyline nods are for Tom and Belle's ongoing coercive control plot, as well as Rhona's court battle for baby Ivy.

![Image 2: tom and belle king in emmerdale](https://hips.hearstapps.com/hmg-prod/images/james-chase-tom-eden-taylor-draper-belle-emmerdale-65d78fc46cab5.jpeg?resize=980:*)

The Best Daytime Soap category features nods for [_Doctors_](https://www.digitalspy.com/soaps/doctors/), [_Home and Away_](https://www.digitalspy.com/soaps/home-and-away/) and _[Neighbours](https://www.digitalspy.com/soaps/neighbours/),_ while the primetime Best Soap category sees _Coronation Street_, _EastEnders_, _Emmerdale_ and _Hollyoaks_ nominated for the award.

One new category is for Best Pet, where David the dog (_Coronation Street_), Freddie the dog (_Coronation Street_), Jasper the parrot (_EastEnders_), Tyson the dog (_EastEnders_), Ice the horse (_Emmerdale_), and Piper the dog (_Emmerdale_) are all up.

“Over 90,000 soap fans vote each year in The Inside Soap Awards,” Inside Soap magazine editor Gary Gillatt said in a statement. “They remain, after three decades, the only accolades of their kind to be awarded based solely on the votes of viewers – there’s no ‘expert juries’ taking charge here.

"There’s some incredible talent and epic storylines on the 2024 nominees’ list, and we can’t wait to discover who the discerning readers of Inside Soap choose to honour this year.”

Joel has now been left begging for Dee-Dee's forgiveness, explaining that he is in the process of divorcing his wife but has been battling to see his young daughter.

But with Joel at the forefront of Corrie's latest scandal, what do we know about the actor who plays him, Calum Lill? Before joining Corrie, Calum could be found flogging cars as he took on different jobs - including a stint at Junkyard Golf Club - in between acting gigs - which included an appearance in 2021 on Hollyoaks in which he played PC Carlton Smith in the Channel 4 soap.

But Calum's big break actually came shortly after he graduated. "I had one episode on Doctors – it was two days filming and you’d think I’d just been cast as the lead in the new Scorsese epic," he laughed when speaking to the Manchester Evening News. He went on: "Then I did an episode on Holby City which was fantastic and then lockdown hit... That threw a spanner in the works."

![Image 3: A dark-skinned woman is talking to a light-skinned man wearing a dark suit; they are both in a business office](https://i2-prod.manchestereveningnews.co.uk/article28695698.ece/ALTERNATES/s1200e/0_JSR_MEN_040823_Corrie.jpg)

View 3 Images

Joel soon struck up a romance with Dee-Dee(Image: ITV)

And Calum was soon creating a link with some former Corrie stars. After eventually getting 12 episodes of Hollyoaks in 2021, he ended up working on a paella stand at festivals, working for Jenny Platt and Rupert Hill.

"The owner of it, his brother is Rupert [Hill] and his partner Jenny [Platt], they used to be in Coronation Street," he said, speaking of the actors who portrayed Jamie Baldwin and Violet Wilson in the show with it recently confirmed that Jenny will be temporarily returning to the cobbles.

He added: "I’d had an unsuccessful audition at Corrie before and they said, 'If they like you, they will get you back in, do not worry'. I was a bit down because if you’re working class and northern, all you want to do is something on Coronation Street."

![Image 4: A man and a woman standing close together with some drinks, smiling in a lit, busy bar](https://i2-prod.manchestereveningnews.co.uk/article28695705.ece/ALTERNATES/s1200e/0_JSR_MEN_230224_CalumLill.jpg)

View 3 Images

Calum with his girlfriend Roberta(Image: Calum Lill Instagram)

Calum has moved to Manchester with his girlfriend and worked alongside acting to save for a house, describing the experience as "tough". He went on: "Then it came along and I've never felt anything like it. I was walking on air. I felt incredible – especially being a working class northern lad. To know I've got a part in an institution like Coronation Street, it's the most incredible thing."

Speaking of his girlfriend Roberta Mcclarron's reaction to him getting the part, Lill said: "It wasn't just happiness for me getting the job, she knew what I was going through and that I was struggling. I wasn't happy in the job that I was doing. She knew that I was putting on a brave face, but how down I was. It was a relief that 14 or 15 years had paid off and I wouldn't have to quit. There's no shame in quitting. So many people have to. It's one of the hardest industries to get into. But to know I didn't have to was incredible."

Article continues below

And Calum and Roberta, who works in PR and marketing, are very clearly loved-up. Back in early December, the pair celebrated their anniversary fo Calum sharing a string of snaps of them both on social media. "Three years of mischief," he typed in the Instagram caption, adding: "Here’s to many more. Love you @robertamcclarron."
